s: Suez Canal Connects –
x: The Suez Canal is an artificial sea-level waterway located in Isthmus of Suez in Egypt. It is 193.30 km long. This canal connects the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea. It became operational in 1869. Tewfik Port (Suez Port) is located to the south of Suez Canal and Port Said is located to its north. It is the largest artificial navigational canal in the world. Suez Canal reduced the maritime distance between Europe and India by 7,000 km. 2. s: Through which one of the following straits does a tunnel connect the United Kingdom and France ?
x: Dover Strait marks the boundary between the English Channel and the North Sea. There are three marine tunnels through Dover Strait on the eastern part of English channel that connect England and France. These tunnels Connect Folkestone in Kent of England with Coquelles in Pas-de- Calais France.

s: Panama Canal Connects –
x: The Panama Canal is a major ship canal of Central America. It was constructed by cutting across the Isthmus of Panama. It connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean. This canal has significantly reduced the distance between San Francisco (on the western coast) and New York (on the eastern coast).

The two islands are connected by the undersea railway Seikan Tunnel. Shikoku is the smallest and least populous of the four main islands of Japan. Kyushu is the third largest island of Japan.
